description: Tester fixtures (ADR-0173, #225). Each entry pins the bytes the tester decodes by SHA-256 and records the licence of those bytes. Verified offline; fetched at most once into the cache. netflix-bar is not listed: its licence is unconfirmed and it is not shipped until it is.

generate.note: seed=1 is required: the filter is random without it. Hash pinned against FFmpeg n9.0.2.
